```
ps aux | grep python
```
This command will show you a list of all the running Python processes and their PIDs.

In Windows:
```
tasklist | findstr python
```

```
kill -TERM <PID>
```

Replace `<PID>` with the actual process ID.

In Windows:
```
taskkill /F /PID <PID>
```
Replace `<PID>` with the actual process ID.
